metadata.description: Sample product dataset for Dynamic Content Strategy walkthrough. 30 products across 3 platforms, each with vendor-submitted raw titles (intentionally broken) and AI-enriched titles at 4 tiers.

lite.label: Lite
lite.description: Baseline hygiene. Fix typos, normalize caps/units. Cheapest model.

pro.label: Pro
pro.description: Category guidelines. Brand positioning. Light variant grouping.

plus.label: Plus
plus.description: Granular guidelines. Full variant dedup. Deep attributes.

enterprise.label: Enterprise
enterprise.description: Best model. Trust-class validation. Image verification.

variantGroupExample.description: Products that should be grouped as variants of the same product family. Variant grouping only happens at Plus and Enterprise tiers.
variantGroupExample.appExperience: Customer sees a variant picker: 500mL / 1L / 2L / 3L on one product page instead of 4 separate listings

categoryPredictionExamples.description: Examples showing correct predictions, wrong predictions, and the correction flow.

wrong.reason: Model sees 'Nescafe' and defaults to instant coffee. Misses that Dolce Gusto capsules are a separate L3 category.
Low-confidence prediction. AutoML (V1, text-only) cannot distinguish chocolate bars from biscuits without image signal.
Gel format confuses the model. Category 'Topical Pain Relief' has zero ground truth examples in the golden dataset.

correctionPatterns.description: Common correction patterns that content agents repeat daily because corrections never feed back.
